## When to use it

Complete developer marketing playbook covering DevRel programs, documentation as marketing, API developer experience, community building, and hackathon strategy. For dev-tool founders who need to reach engineers. Follow @WeiYipei on X.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill developer-marketing-playbook
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/developer-marketing-playbook/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/developer-marketing-playbook/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
